description: Search Laboratory.love’s published product-test records. Use this before answering whether a product, brand, or category has been tested. Records are either Laboratory.love-commissioned tests or clearly labeled PlasticList-derived historical records; report which. Results describe the samples tested, not every unit of a product. Covers chemicals that come from plastics (phthalates, BPA and other bisphenols, and phthalate substitutes), the usual meaning of "plastic chemicals" in food; it does not measure microplastic particles, so say so if someone asks about microplastics. Read-only.

analyte.description: Analyte abbreviation or name from list_analytes, e.g. DEHP or BPA. Keeps only results where it was measured.

brand.description: Brand words. PlasticList records have no separate brand field, so this also matches their product name.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call with the same filters.

detected.description: With analyte: true keeps results where that analyte was detected in at least one sample; false keeps results where it was measured but never detected. Without analyte: any analyte.

q.description: Words to match in the product name, brand, category, or tags, e.g. "Coca-Cola Zero" or "tofu".

sort.description: Defaults to relevance when q is given, otherwise tested_on_desc.

tag.description: A PlasticList source tag such as "sodas" or "baby_food".

name: search_results
title: Search published test results
